description: Port of ESLint's `default-param-last` rule (https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/default-param-last) on JavaScript files. A defaulted parameter (`AssignmentPattern`, the grammar's `assignment_pattern`) of a function, arrow or method is reported when a required parameter follows it: a plain, object or array pattern without a default. A rest parameter neither counts as required nor is reported, as ESLint's `isRequiredParameter`. The rule has no options; TypeScript's optional parameters are typescript-eslint-default-param-last's.
